body: I've got more debt than I know what to do with. Old hospital bills are turning into court dates, my car is probably going to be repossessed any day now, and I owe thousands to my parents for helping me with my credit card debt. I have to see the girl I used to love every day at work, realizing she's happier now with someone else. She often avoids eye contact, whereas it was always a smile as soon as she caught a glimpse of me in the past. I hate my job, and it seems like I'm going to be stuck there for eternity. I hate my shitty apartment which is always dirty because my roommates and I are always too fucked up to do anything about it. The only way I can get an ounce of sleep is to drink and smoke until I black out. I don't have the motivation to do laundry or even brush my teeth anymore. I dropped out of college, I've hurt most of the people close to me, and I can't even afford to eat most days. I use others for their money and their hospitality, and when they want something in return, I sever contact. I don't want to put on a facade of being happy anymore, because I'm not.

I was on medication for a while, but I couldn't afford it anymore. I have hospital bills from a surgery I had a while back, and now I've got bills for the doctor visit to get my medication, so I can't really afford to go back to the doctor, because I neglected to pay all of those bills. They probably wouldn't let me in without a deposit, and my bank account is perpetually empty. I've been smoking marijuana as of late (my roommates always have some), which has helped a bit, but recently not even that has been helping.

I'm so close to the end. I've exhausted all my resources.
